title: THE ROXZONE · SUPERSET CLOCK
why: GREEN (8 h sleep, shoulders/back a little sore from the 60 lb bell, energy high) after a planned rest day. Shape rotates to grind+ballistic SUPERSETS on a 3:00 clock (Neupert G&B family, unused this window), dressed as a HYROX race: 8 stations from the HYROX menu (the loaded station-7 carry, burpee broad jumps, wall balls, sled pull/push, ski, sit-ups) translated to your bells. Overhead volume is kept light and the 60 lb stays in a hug, not a swing, to respect the shoulders and back.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine (the sore bits)

items.name: Shoulder dislocates ×10 (towel or 35 lb handle, wide)
Jefferson curl ×6 (35 lb, slow roll down)

blocks.title: THE ROXZONE · EVERY 3:00 · 8 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 8 ROUNDS · 24:00 · one SUPERSET (grind ×N then ballistic ×N, unbroken) + one LEG per round · rest what is left of the 3:00
blocks.format: Pairs P1-P4 run in order, then repeat (rounds 1-4, then 5-8). Score = rounds finished inside their 3:00 window.
blocks.workRest: LEG alternates: odd rounds 0.25 mi flat @ 8.5 mph (the race run); even rounds 0.15 mi @ 6.5 mph / 8% (the sled push). 1.6 mi total.

items.name: P1 · Bear-hug 60 lb step-up ×8/side → burpee broad jump ×6
items.detail: HYROX station 7 + BBJ · bench step-up, bell hugged high; burpee, then a real broad jump, turn, repeat

items.name: P2 · Hand-release push-up ×15 → KB thruster 35 lb ×15
items.detail: wall balls · thruster fast, punch the bell up, catch it at the chest

items.name: P3 · Sit-up 35 lb ×15 (bell hugged) → double high pull 2×45 lb ×10
items.detail: sit-ups + sled pull · high pulls from a swing, elbows high

items.name: P4 · Renegade row 2×45 lb ×5/side → swing 35 lb ×20
items.detail: WILDCARD renegade row (last seen 09-10) · swings fast and snappy = the SkiErg

items.name: LEG · 0.25 mi @ 8.5 flat (odd) / 0.15 mi @ 6.5 · 8% (even)
items.detail: straight off the ballistic onto the belt

blocks.noteGreen: Green = 8 of 8 rounds inside their windows. Stretch = rounds 9-10 repeating P1 + P2 with the flat leg @ 9.0. Log which round ran over, the slowest pair, RPE.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 6 rounds (skip the round-7/8 repeat of P3/P4), even legs at 6.0 / 6%.
blocks.text: Bear-hug step-up: 60 lb bell wrapped in both arms at the chest, full foot on the bench, stand tall, control the step down. Burpee broad jump: chest to floor, up, jump for distance with feet together, land soft. Thruster: squat, then punch the bell overhead as you stand, one motion. Double high pull: hike both bells, hinge-and-snap, pull the bells to chest height with elbows high, drop and re-hike. Renegade row: bells under shoulders, feet wide, row without the hips opening.

blocks.title: THE ROXZONE FINISH · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · anti-rotation + anti-extension close · straight through

items.name: Tall-kneeling halo 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: knees down, ribs stacked, slow circles

items.name: Lying leg raise ×12
items.detail: low back glued to the floor the whole way
